title: Interview eval reads a generated brief snapshot, not a hand-kept Python port
deviations_from_card: Critic revise applied: the snapshot carries a per-kind `fallbackRole`, derived by rendering each builder with role '' and solving for the string that stood where the sentinel was (deriveFallback refuses if the empty render is not the template with one fallback substituted); Python applies it when role_line is empty; the node:test proves every kind's fallback against its builder, and the '' role is in acceptance 2. Snapshot shape is {schema, sentinel, regenerate, kinds:{kind:{template, fallbackRole}}}. The grounded fixture chronology now lives in scripts/interview-briefs-snapshot.ts (GROUNDED_FIXTURE_CHRONOLOGY) and scripts/interview-brief.ts gained `--brief grounded` over the same renderKind; scripts/interview-brief-grounded.ts (not in the write set) was left untouched. `--briefs` stays one release as a no-op that prints a note, in interview_eval AND interview_optimize. run_gated.py's SKIP_BASELINE default also dropped 5 -> 4 alongside ci.yml. test_run_gated's env-conditional fixtures now pass env_conditional=1 explicitly (the mechanism stays; only the committed count is 0). Ruff/typecheck: `npm run typecheck` not run (schemas:gen would touch generated files under siblings); tsc run directly instead.
notes: tsc exit 2 is FOREIGN only: untracked kpi-sim/ (a sibling/operator copy of the tree) plus app/_lib/candidate-timeline.test.ts (sibling in-flight); none of my files error. test:unit exit 1 is only the known Windows FLAKE in app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts (process-tree kill). test:perf exit 1 is FOREIGN: measured by git-archive of committed trees, the budget is green at b38accca6~1, and 5a3344c5e (before my feat) and b49819944 (after) have the identical 11 overage lines (app/page.tsx, hire-from-need, devcase/lifecycle, ...) — they arrive with sibling commits (schedule-interview-prep afb029b67 / devcase-lifecycle), and my change adds nothing to any app graph (scripts/, Python, one test file). review:constitution 0 blocking, 1 note (gate-configuration: ci.yml/run_gated.py/skip-register.json edited — the edit is a LOWERING of KP_SKIP_BASELINE 5 -> 4, a repair per change-review.md; the rate-limit-contract path in that note is a sibling's). Revert caveat from the card stands: reverting needs `Gate-exemption: skip-baseline-raised at .github/workflows/ci.yml — reverting the brief-snapshot series`. The python-gate CI job now runs TestBriefSnapshot without node_modules (reads the JSON only).
